title: SBI, MS Strategic, BoB and insurers may cut stake sale in NSE IPO
text: SBI, MS Strategic, BoB and insurers may cut stake sale in NSE IPO. Issue size likely to come down to around 5.1-5.2 per cent of NSE’s equity, compared with 6 per cent earlier
